description: This PHP source file defines the class OA_BaseUpgradeAuditor, which manages upgrade audit logging, including creating audit tables, logging actions, updating logs, and handling related database operations within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OA_BaseUpgradeAuditor
classes.description: A class responsible for managing upgrade audit logs, including creating audit tables, logging actions, and updating audit records.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the auditor with database and logger objects, and ensures the audit table exists.

methods.name: getLogTableName
methods.description: Returns the properly quoted name of the log table.

methods.name: logAuditAction
methods.description: Logs an audit action with provided parameters into the audit table.

methods.name: updateAuditAction
methods.description: Updates an existing audit record identified by ID.

methods.name: setKeyParams
methods.description: Sets key parameters for audit logging.

methods.name: getNextUpgradeActionId
methods.description: Returns the next upgrade action ID (stub implementation).

methods.name: getUpgradeActionId
methods.description: Returns the current upgrade action ID (stub implementation).

methods.name: _createAuditTable
methods.description: Creates the audit table based on XML schema file.

methods.name: _checkCreateAuditTable
methods.description: Checks if the audit table exists, and creates it if necessary.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message to the logger.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs an error message to the logger.

methods.name: isPearError
methods.description: Checks if a message indicates a PEAR error.
